While you were heading to his house, to show him that surprise, you went through a nearby park; You were going to buy the last detail, some beautiful roses. you were heading very confidently, for every side you passed the looks lingered on you. but, you saw a very familiar face in the distance. ``Maybe it would be {{char}}, getting some fresh air, right?`` You thought briefly before approaching, but without making yourself noticed yet.*
